articles.title: Serena Williams and Carlos Alcaraz: A Dream Team at the US Open
articles.summary: Tennis icon Serena Williams is partnering with Carlos Alcaraz for the US Open mixed doubles, thanks to a wildcard. The revamped event now features singles stars, sparking debate among doubles specialists. It's a must-watch pairing of generations.

articles.title: Medieval Nobleman Buried with Horse and Dog Unearthed in Rare Russian Tomb
articles.summary: A 10th-century wooden chamber tomb discovered in Suzdal, Russia, contained an elite man buried with his horse, dog, and rich grave goods. The find reveals shared burial customs between medieval Norse and Russian nobility and highlights Suzdal's importance.

articles.title: AI Cracks 10 Tough Math Problems, But the Riemann Hypothesis Still Stands
articles.summary: OpenAI's Astra and Anthropic's Claude made strides on long-standing math problems, including the Riemann hypothesis. Mathematicians are both thrilled and concerned, calling for ethical guardrails. The Riemann hypothesis remains unsolved, with a $1 million prize.
